description: Complete Pawn environment for SA-MP / open.mp: compile from any file, syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, error lens, GitHub package manager and server debugging with crashdetect.
command.packages.signIn: Sign in to GitHub (raises the search limit)
welcome.compile:
No compilation yet in this session.
[$(play) Compile](command:pawnStudio.compile)
[$(run-all) Compile all](command:pawnStudio.compileAll)
Tip: F5 compiles from any .pwn/.inc file.
welcome.packages:
This project has no pawn.json yet — it is the file that lists the packages.
[Create pawn.json](command:pawnStudio.packages.init)
[$(add) Install a package](command:pawnStudio.packages.install)
welcome.server:
Server not found. Put samp-server.exe / omp-server.exe in the project folder or configure its path.
[Configure path](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22pawnStudio.server.path%22)
debugger.label: SA-MP / open.mp Server
debugger.target: Main .pwn file to compile (default: detected automatically / pawn.json entry).
debugger.serverPath: Path to samp-server.exe / omp-server.exe (or its folder). Default: detected automatically.
debugger.logFile: Log file to follow (default: server_log.txt / log.txt).
debugger.stopOnError: Stop at the error line when crashdetect reports a runtime error.
debugger.snippet.label: Pawn: Start server
debugger.snippet.description: Compiles and starts the SA-MP / open.mp server
color.errorLensErrorBackground: Background of a line with an error
color.errorLensWarningBackground: Background of a line with a warning
color.errorLensInfoBackground: Background of a line with info
config.compilerPath: Path to `pawncc`. Empty = searches `pawno/` and `qawno/` going up from the main file, then the `PATH`. Accepts `${workspaceFolder}`.
config.includePaths: Extra include folders (`-i`). Package folders, `pawno/include` and the server root `include/` are added automatically.
config.args: Extra `pawncc` arguments. Keep `-d3` so crashdetect can show the file and line of errors.
config.outputDirectory: Folder for the `.amx`. Empty = same folder as the `.pwn` (or the `output` of `pawn.json`).
config.entry: Pinned target: when set, **every** file compiles this `.pwn`. Use the *Pawn: Pin compile target* command.
config.lintOnSave: On save, runs pawncc in the background (in a temporary folder, without touching the `.amx`).
config.revealOutput: When to show the **Pawn Studio** panel (bottom panel) with the compilation: target, time, `.amx` size, memory and errors.
config.entryExclude: Glob of folders that never contain main files.
config.errorLens.enabled: Show errors and warnings at the end of the line.
config.errorLens.showWarnings: Include warnings in the error lens.
config.errorLens.allLanguages: Also apply the error lens to non-Pawn files.
config.lint.quick: Quick analysis **on every keystroke** (milliseconds, no pawncc): unmatched braces/parentheses, unterminated strings, missing `;`, missing includes, undefined functions and wrong argument counts.
config.lint.onType: Runs pawncc in the background **without saving** (compiles a temporary copy with the unsaved text). In large YSI projects this can take tens of seconds; the quick analysis covers the gap.
config.lint.delay: Idle time (ms) before calling pawncc in the background while typing.
config.server.path: Path to `samp-server.exe` / `omp-server.exe` (or the server folder). Empty = searches going up from the workspace.
config.packages.checkUpdatesOnStartup: Check for package updates when opening the project.
config.completion.parameters: What to insert when accepting a function in autocomplete (Tab/Enter).
config.completion.parameters.enum.requir: Fills the required parameters (no default value) — Tab jumps between them
config.completion.parameters.enum.all: Fills all parameters, including those with default values
config.language: Language of the extension messages. `auto` follows the VS Code display language. (Menus and settings always follow VS Code.)
command.tools.selectGta: Select the GTA San Andreas folder
config.gtaPath: GTA San Andreas folder (the one with `gta_sa.exe`), used by the object, sprite, animation and sound finders. Empty = detect automatically (SA-MP registry key and common folders).
config.dialogs.codeStyle: Code generated by the Dialog Creator.
config.dialogs.codeStyle.auto: Detect from the project (easyDialog if it uses Dialog_Show / Dialog:)
